paite: Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip hi; la ka sa ding, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding, ka thupina teng toh.
heading: David phatna La / Melmate Dou Dia Panpihna Ngetna

paite: Pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zaw zingkhang in ka halh ding.
TOUPA aw, michih lakte ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; mite lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
Na zahngaihna van khup in athupi a, na thutak in vandumte asun hial hi.
Pathian aw, nang van khen ah pahtawi in hong om in; na thupinate leitung tengteng tung ah pahtawi in om hen.
Na deihtakte humbit a a-omtheihna ding un, na khut taklam in hondam inla, hon dawng in.
Pathian in asianthouna ah hiai bang in agen a, Nuam ka sa ding; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth Phaizang ka hawmzak ding.
Gilead gam kei a ahi a; Manasseh gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi a; Edom gam ah ka khedap ka pai ding a; Philistia gam ka kikoukhum ding hi.
Khopi kulh nei ah kua'n ahon pilut dia? Edom gam ah kua'n ahon pi dia?
Pathian aw, nang hon khahkhia hilou na hi maw? Pathian aw, ka sepaihhonte uh kiang ah lah na pawt ngal kei a.
Galte sual ding in hon panpih in; mihing panpihna zaw bangmah lou phet ahi.
Pathian ziak in hangtak in ka hih ding uh; amah lah hon doute sikdenpa ding ahi ngal a.
